thread:
lia: quick alert — canary in eu-west hitting repeated failures during `restore-cache` + `extract` steps; looks like ephemeral runner storage pressure.
omar: failing step is `integration-tests` after cache restore. logs point to write errors and truncated tar.
ci-bot: Job 6123: restore-cache timed out (120s) -> partial restore -> artifact-verify: checksum mismatch.
maya: paste runner output snippet:
```
2026-04-02T14:12:07Z runner-77: INFO: starting restore-cache for job 6123
2026-04-02T14:14:09Z runner-77: ERROR: restore-cache timed out after 120s
2026-04-02T14:14:11Z runner-77: ERROR: tar: unexpected EOF while reading
2026-04-02T14:14:11Z runner-77: ERROR: write /tmp/extract-zz/dep.whl: no space left on device
```
lia: this pattern matches earlier disk eviction incidents when many pipelines restore simultaneously.
release-manager: what's the impact to the promotion?
omar: deploybot auto-hold engaged — 3/6 nodes passed, remaining failing in the same autoscaled runner pool. promotion blocked.
maya: proposed mitigations: (A) reduce restore parallelism for canary runs, (B) pin to last-known-good digest so we can unblock, (C) reprovision runner pool with larger ephemeral or switch to reuse runners.
lia: short-term I'd pick (B) + (A). pin to avoid rollback churn; throttle restores while infra investigates.
release-manager: how do we execute the pin?
omar: `deploybot promo pin <digest>` is available. last-good digest: sha256:c4e2f1b...

infra-bot: created INFRA-2026: ephemeral-runner: investigate disk pressure/inode exhaustion and adjust tmp cleanup. tagging @infra-team.
